steps.title: Start
steps.text: OntoDB stores the materials ontology. Aegis versions it and writes each version into Mneme as a memory, so agents can derive their work from a version.

steps.title: KROMA aligns the ontology with MatOnto
steps.text: A user posts match requests to the shared memory. KROMA's matcher picks them up from the blackboard and writes a verdict for each pair.

steps.title: Ask MOIRA, then ask again in other words
steps.text: MOIRA's answerer reads the hierarchy and KROMA's matches, and writes an answer derived from the current ontology version and every match it read. The reworded question is served from MOIRA's cache.

steps.text: The detector's workload harm is 0.500, over its threshold of 0.05. Aegis rolls the ontology back to lsn 2, the honest edit. Every memory derived from the poisoned version goes stale, and MOIRA's cache drops the poisoned answer.
